messages.subject: need stepsize jitter?
parts:
We have that in HMC now, but I think Michael wanted to get rid of
it. That'd be OK with me if nobody's using it.

- Bob

messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] need stepsize jitter?
parts:
It doesn’t really help — in cases where there is position-dependent
curvature the jitter would have to be huge to to get any kind of
implicit adaptation. And then it would be extremely wasteful as
most of the step sizes would not be optimal anywhere, and you’d
get stuck trying to randomly sample the few locally-optimal values.
